name: demand-letter-drafter
description: Demand Letter & Client Correspondence Drafter — Claude Desktop plugin that populates a firm's demand-letter template with case facts and drafts plain-English client status updates for solo and small-firm attorneys

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run pack && npm run checksum
scripts.release: npm run build && gh release create v$npm_package_version $npm_package_name-v$npm_package_version.zip $npm_package_name-v$npm_package_version.zip.sha256 --title "v$npm_package_version" --notes-file RELEASE.md
